en.hubeali:
Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ali Bin Asbat, from Al Hakam Bin Miskeen, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara and a group of people with him who said, 
‘We heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying:
‘The Imam<sup>asws</sup> who is after recognises the knowledge of the one<sup>asws</sup> who was before him<sup>asws</sup> during the last minute remaining from his<sup>asws</sup> soul’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ali ibn Asbat from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah and a group with him who has said the following. “We heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘
The succeeding Imam comes to know of the knowledge of the preceding Imam in the last minute of the time left from his life.’”
